purpose: Materialize and validate all 267 canonical Hero detail records from frozen Stage 4/5 blocks through the Stage 6-1 composition index after Stage 6-2 representative fixture QA.

materializedRecord.presentation: Stage 5-5 fields except heroId and identity
materializedRecord.normal: Stage 4 record except repeated hero identity keys
materializedRecord.exclusiveEquipment: Stage 5-2 exclusiveEquipment block, parity-checked against the frozen Stage B canonical relation
materializedRecord.soldiers: Hero usable-Soldier IDs from the frozen Stage 5-3 shared relation output

storage.reason: Avoid forcing ordinary GitHub/site consumers to read or diff one very large monolithic Hero-detail Blob while preserving exactly one canonical generated record per Hero.

sharedPayload.soldiersById: Store the Stage 5-3 Soldier metadata map once in hero-detail-shared.v1.json; do not duplicate Soldier metadata per Hero shard.

classification.FAIL: Missing/duplicate canonical Hero, broken Stage 6-1 locator, frozen-block identity mismatch, invalid required structure, canonical exclusive-equipment mismatch, invalid Soldier reference, SP structural mismatch, or missing/duplicate Hero shard.
classification.REVIEW: Site-usable record with presentation-only follow-up such as inherited Soldier Korean localization, missing Korean display text, source-path delivery work, or intentionally unencoded skin acquisition metadata.
classification.PASS: No structural failure and no record-level presentation review.
classification.siteUsable: PASS and REVIEW are site-usable; FAIL is not.

hardErrorPolicy: Do not infer Hero relationships from IDs, names, ordering, filenames, or chronology.
Do not re-run Stage 4 or Stage 5 semantic research in Stage 6-3.
Do not rebuild Hero-Soldier membership; consume the frozen relation and validation.
Do not rebuild Hero-exclusive Equipment ownership; consume the frozen Stage B canonical relation.
A declared NOT_RELEASED/absent optional feature is not a JOIN failure; Stage 5-2 equipmentId=0 is an absence sentinel, not an Equipment ID.
Presentation-only localization or web-asset gaps must not be promoted to structural FAIL.
completionGate: 267/267 materialized into 267 unique Hero shards, zero structural FAIL, zero hard errors, frozen Stage 4/5 and Stage 6-1/6-2 gates preserved, canonical Hero-Soldier relation preserved, and Stage B exclusive-equipment relation parity preserved.
